MixedMoments.M_eq_formalM : ∀ (i j : Nat),

    (MixedMoments.Coordinates.eval MixedMoments.Constants.catalan MixedMoments.Zeta.zeta2 (MixedMoments.formalM i j))

  Eq.{1} (MixedMoments.Analysis.polynomialColumn P j)
    (MixedMoments.Coordinates.eval MixedMoments.Constants.catalan MixedMoments.Zeta.zeta2
      (MixedMoments.polynomialM P j))
MixedMoments.integral_exact_defect : ∀ (P D : Polynomial.{0} Rat) (j : Nat),
  Eq.{1}
    (HSub.hSub.{0, 0, 0} (MixedMoments.Analysis.polynomialColumn P j)
      (HMul.hMul.{0, 0, 0} (3 / 2) (MixedMoments.Zeta.polynomialColumn D j)))
    (HAdd.hAdd.{0, 0, 0}
      (HAdd.hAdd.{0, 0, 0} (↑(MixedMoments.rationalWitness P D j))
        (HMul.hMul.{0, 0, 0} (↑(MixedMoments.catalanWitness P j)) MixedMoments.Constants.catalan))
      (HMul.hMul.{0, 0, 0} (↑(HMul.hMul.{0, 0, 0} (3 / 2) (MixedMoments.polynomialDefect P D j)))
        MixedMoments.Zeta.zeta2))
MixedMoments.integral_cancellation_of_coefficientContact : ∀ (P D : Polynomial.{0} Rat) (L j : Nat),
  MixedMoments.CoefficientContact P D L →
    LT.lt.{0} j L →
      Eq.{1}
        (HSub.hSub.{0, 0, 0} (MixedMoments.Analysis.polynomialColumn P j)
          (HMul.hMul.{0, 0, 0} (3 / 2) (MixedMoments.Zeta.polynomialColumn D j)))
        (HAdd.hAdd.{0, 0, 0} (↑(MixedMoments.rationalWitness P D j))
          (HMul.hMul.{0, 0, 0} (↑(MixedMoments.catalanWitness P j)) MixedMoments.Constants.catalan))
MixedMoments.integral_cancellation_witnesses : ∀ (P D : Polynomial.{0} Rat) (L j : Nat),
  MixedMoments.CoefficientContact P D L →
    LT.lt.{0} j L →
      ∃ a b,

    (∑ i ∈ Polynomial.support.{0} D, HMul.hMul.{0, 0, 0} (↑(Polynomial.coeff.{0} D i)) (MixedMoments.Zeta.kernel i j p))
MixedMoments.Zeta.integrable_columnKernel : ∀ (D : Polynomial.{0} Rat) (j : Nat),
  MeasureTheory.Integrable.{0, 0} (MixedMoments.Zeta.columnKernel D j) MixedMoments.Zeta.squareMeasure
MixedMoments.Zeta.polynomialColumn_eq_sum : ∀ (D : Polynomial.{0} Rat) (j : Nat),
  Eq.{1} (MixedMoments.Zeta.polynomialColumn D j)
    (∑ i ∈ Polynomial.support.{0} D, HMul.hMul.{0, 0, 0} (↑(Polynomial.coeff.{0} D i)) (MixedMoments.Zeta.Z i j))
MixedMoments.Zeta.polynomialKernel : Polynomial.{0} Rat → Polynomial.{0} Rat → Prod.{0, 0} Real Real → Real
MixedMoments.Zeta.polynomialIntegral : Polynomial.{0} Rat → Polynomial.{0} Rat → Real
MixedMoments.Zeta.polynomialKernel_eq_sum : ∀ (D Q : Polynomial.{0} Rat) (p : Prod.{0, 0} Real Real),
  Eq.{1} (MixedMoments.Zeta.polynomialKernel D Q p)
    (∑ i ∈ Polynomial.support.{0} D,
      ∑ j ∈ Polynomial.support.{0} Q,
        HMul.hMul.{0, 0, 0} (HMul.hMul.{0, 0, 0} ↑(Polynomial.coeff.{0} D i) ↑(Polynomial.coeff.{0} Q j))
          (MixedMoments.Zeta.kernel i j p))
MixedMoments.Zeta.integrable_polynomialKernel : ∀ (D Q : Polynomial.{0} Rat),
  MeasureTheory.Integrable.{0, 0} (MixedMoments.Zeta.polynomialKernel D Q) MixedMoments.Zeta.squareMeasure
MixedMoments.Zeta.polynomialIntegral_eq_sum : ∀ (D Q : Polynomial.{0} Rat),
  Eq.{1} (MixedMoments.Zeta.polynomialIntegral D Q)
    (∑ i ∈ Polynomial.support.{0} D,
      ∑ j ∈ Polynomial.support.{0} Q,
        HMul.hMul.{0, 0, 0} (HMul.hMul.{0, 0, 0} ↑(Polynomial.coeff.{0} D i) ↑(Polynomial.coeff.{0} Q j))
          (MixedMoments.Zeta.Z i j))
MixedMoments.Zeta.polynomialColumn_eq_iterated : ∀ (D : Polynomial.{0} Rat) (j : Nat),
  Eq.{1} (MixedMoments.Zeta.polynomialColumn D j)
    (∫ (t : Real) (s : Real) in 0..1,
      HDiv.hDiv.{0, 0, 0}
        (HMul.hMul.{0, 0, 0} (Polynomial.eval₂.{0, 0} (Rat.castHom.{0} Real) t D) (HPow.hPow.{0, 0, 0} s j))
        (HSub.hSub.{0, 0, 0} 1 (HMul.hMul.{0, 0, 0} t s)))
MixedMoments.Zeta.Z_eq_formalZ : ∀ (G : Real) (i j : Nat),
  Eq.{1} (MixedMoments.Zeta.Z i j) (MixedMoments.Coordinates.eval G MixedMoments.Zeta.zeta2 (MixedMoments.formalZ i j))

  Eq.{1} (MixedMoments.Zeta.polynomialColumn D j)
    (MixedMoments.Coordinates.eval G MixedMoments.Zeta.zeta2 (MixedMoments.polynomialZ D j))
